review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: Registering VeltAutocompleteOptionWireframe REPLACES Velt's default .velt-autocomplete-option--container option markup; the live selectable row becomes .mat-mdc-option (gets .mat-mdc-option-active on the highlighted row) wrapping your wireframe template. Target .mat-mdc-option for the row + your own wrapper class for the content.
learnings.evidence: Loop2 explore: pre-register 4x .velt-autocomplete-option--container; post-register 0 of that class, 4 .vc-ac-option + .mat-mdc-option-active present

learnings.statement: The @mention autocomplete picker renders in a body-level Angular-Material CDK overlay (.mat-mdc-autocomplete-panel / .velt-autocomplete-panel--container), NOT inside the comments-sidebar wireframe subtree. Style it with GLOBAL classes and measure it with surfaceSelector pinned to the overlay, not the sidebar.
learnings.evidence: Loop2: querySelector('.velt-autocomplete-panel--container') resolves at document/body level; sidebar-scoped surface gave viewport-absolute coordinates

learnings.statement: Velt *-wireframe custom elements (and vc-* classes placed directly on slot wrappers) are display:contents / 0x0 in the DOM. Drive/measure against the SIZED inner Velt classes (.velt-composer-input--message, .velt-comments-sidebar, .velt-thread-card--container) — a waitFor(visible) or capture on a -wireframe tag times out / captures an empty shell.
learnings.evidence: Loop2: velt-comments-sidebar-wireframe 0x0 vs velt-comments-sidebar 353x937; drive waitFor on -wireframe timed out

learnings.statement: The page-mode composer and every comment's inline reply composer SHARE the same vc-*/.velt-composer-input--message classes; querySelector returns whichever is first in DOM (often a 0x0 collapsed reply composer). Scope selectors to .velt-sidebar-page-mode-composer to target the page-mode composer deterministically.
learnings.evidence: Loop2: first .vc-page-mode-composer-composer-container-root was a 0x0 reply composer; .velt-sidebar-page-mode-composer is unique+sized (353x42)
